question: Distance between A and B is 1200 km. If they start moving towards each other at same time, they will meet in 24 hrs. If A starts 10 hrs after B, then they will meet after another 20 hrs. What are their respective speeds?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance between A and B = 1200 km

If A and B move towards each other at the same time, they meet in 24 hrs.

If A starts 10 hrs after B, they meet after another 20 hrs.

Formula used:

Time = Distance/Speed

Distance = Speed × Time

Relative speed of two bodies when they travel towards each other = Sum of their speed
